components.label: Lambda HTTP Handler
components.role: AWS Lambda POST /run; validates x-api-key; assembles BriefBundle from the request body + in-memory sidecar mock; builds BARE Bedrock agents (NO tools wired); caches them across warm invocations; calls orchestrator.run() (lambda_handler.py:131,203)

components.label: Mapping-MCP agent runner (entry)
components.role: scudo_mapping_mcp/agent.py: ScriptedMappingAgent / BedrockMappingAgent.run(ref) drives the 4-tool loop; reached by MCP clients via the 3 tiers. Separate process from the Lambda orchestrator.

components.label: Orchestrator.run() router + bundle
components.role: Routes IntakeRequest (RESEARCH|NEW|EXTEND|RECONCILE); assembles BriefBundle with candidates, precedents, conflicts; pins ontology_snapshot & rubric_version

components.label: Mapping specialist (bare LLM)
components.role: Single _structured_call(MappingResult) to a BARE Bedrock Opus agent — NO tool loop, NO matcher gate (orchestrator.py:151). Lambda's system prompt tells it to set proposed_triples=[] (lambda_handler.py:144). The 4-tool loop + matcher are a SEPARATE runtime (scudo_mapping_mcp).

components.label: Agent tool loop (mapping-MCP)
components.role: SEPARATE runtime (scudo_mapping_mcp/agent.py). Scripted default walks 4 tools IN ORDER (find_similar_products → get_taxonomy_node → get_ontology_neighbourhood → map_vendor_product); Bedrock backend lets the LLM choose order/count, matcher still runs last. map_vendor_product → deterministic matcher gate.

components.label: BedrockMappingAgent
components.role: Strands Agents SDK wrapping Claude Opus 4.8 on Bedrock (eu-west-2); lazy-imported when SCUDO_AGENT_BACKEND=bedrock; routes tool calls via host

components.label: ScriptedMappingAgent
components.role: Deterministic walk over the 4 MCP tools; no Bedrock dependency; DEFAULT backend when SCUDO_AGENT_BACKEND is unset (agent.py:124,140). final_result is the matcher's MappingResult verbatim — 'agent surfaces, matcher gates'.

components.label: map_vendor_product (matcher)
components.role: Deterministic 5-rung cost ladder: scope (layer 2) → precedent → dense+lexical fusion → borderline specialist → floor 0.80; signs verdict

components.label: Scope gate (layers 1-3)
components.role: Deterministic vendor whitelist (PRIORITY_VENDORS: LSEG, S&P, Bloomberg, ICE, FactSet); enforced in ingestion, match_verify, persistence MCPs

components.label: Precedent reuse (I5 check)
components.role: Filters CONFIRMED HITL prior decisions (APPROVED/OVERRIDDEN/REJECTED); excludes provisional auto_mapped edges; preserves audit fields (source_content_hash, source_file_audit_id)

components.label: find_similar_products (Rung 3)
components.role: Multi-path retrieve: BM25 prefilter → drop negative-precedents → dense rescore (Opus or Jaro-Winkler) → RRF fusion (k=60) → rank-signal tilt → top-N

components.label: Opus dense judge
components.role: Bedrock invoke on Claude Opus 4.8; returns semantic [0,1] alignment; fallback Jaro-Winkler when SCUDO_DENSE_FALLBACK=1 or invoke fails

components.label: Specialist scorer (borderline)
components.role: Per-call DI callable invoked ONLY on borderline band (0.75–0.85); anchored to top-N; confidence capped as min(dense, specialist); disagreement routes NEEDS_REVIEW

components.label: 3-band gate (I4)
components.role: PASS (≥0.85): AUTO_MAPPED, no specialist. BORDERLINE (0.75–0.85): consult specialist if wired. FAIL (<0.75): NEEDS_REVIEW

components.label: run_validations (I6)
components.role: 5 deterministic checks (scope_compatible, identifier_resolves, data_class_match, name_length, description_length); required failures force NEEDS_REVIEW

components.label: HMAC-SHA256 verdict seal
components.role: Signs (input_hash, mapped_node_iri, status, confidence, band, ts_ms); v=2 carries band; verify checks shape, HMAC, staleness (max 300s), identity binding

components.label: Pre-verifier guards
components.role: IRI determinism check, evidence-when-confident >0.5, confidence band validation, named-graph presence, proposed_target_iri in candidates

components.label: Verifier agent (10-dim rubric)
components.role: Claude Opus 4.8 scores 10 dimensions (SEMANTIC_FIT, EVIDENCE_USE, CANDIDATE_COVERAGE, etc.) 0/1/2 each; total recomputed to guard arithmetic

components.label: Publish gate + routing
components.role: Deterministic: total<12 OR conf<0.80 OR requires_human_review → HITL; 12≤total≤15 → RETRY; total≥16 AND conf≥0.80 → publish branch (re-checks triples). PublishGateError (empty/malformed triples) propagates to Lambda → HTTP 500 (orchestrator.py:227,262; lambda_handler.py:231).

components.label: IRI determinism regex
components.role: Validates ^(mds\.[a-z0-9_]+:[0-9a-f-]{36}|jpmorgan:data:cdao:.+)$; checked pre-verify and in publish gate

components.label: Named-graph determinism
components.role: orchestrator._named_graph_for reads the single shared graph from proposed_triples; in the Lambda path triples are EMPTY so this raises PublishGateError (orchestrator.py:262). uuid5-based minting is target-state.

components.label: RDF serializer (DCAT stub)
components.role: Fake DCAT serializer (scudo/rdf/fake.py) — deterministic triples + validate_shapes. NOT wired into the live Lambda agents (_build_agents passes no tools; mapper emits proposed_triples=[]). Target-state.

components.label: SHACL shapes (stub)
components.role: Flags only empty/malformed lists; real shapes in /modules/rdf/shapes/ when available

components.label: Research queue
components.role: Routes ontology_gap=True to ResearchQueue; outcome=RESEARCH_QUEUED, never publishes

components.label: HITL queue
components.role: Routes verifier<12 OR conf<0.80 OR requires_human_review; hitl.enqueue(mapping_result, verifier_report, reason)

components.label: Publish sink
components.role: PublishSink protocol; Lambda wires InMemoryPublishSink (appends to a list, stubs.py:70). Production neptune_publish_triples raises NotImplementedError (tools.py:145) — no real publish path yet.

components.label: MappingObject final output
components.role: schema_version, route, bundle_ref, mapping_result, verifier_report, outcome (PUBLISHED|HITL|RETRY|RESEARCH_QUEUED), published_graph, hitl_ticket

components.label: BriefBundle + IntakeRequest
components.role: IntakeRequest(vendor, vendor_product_ref, has_precedent, has_conflict, ontology_gap); BriefBundle carries candidates, precedent, conflicts, ontology_snapshot, rubric_version

components.label: McpHost (transport layer)
components.role: Optional round-robin + circuit breaker + semaphore; routes to 3 MCP tiers (ingestion, match_verify, persistence); gated by SCUDO_MCP_HOST_ENABLED

components.label: Ingestion MCP (tier 1)
components.role: Scope gate layer 1; ingest.list_frames, ingest.get_frame; normalises vendor frames

components.label: Match & Verify MCP (tier 2)
components.role: Scope gate layer 2; 4 read-only tools: find_candidates, get_node, get_neighbourhood, verify_mapping; signs verdicts

components.label: Persistence MCP (tier 3)
components.role: Sole writer; scope gate layer 3; 4 tools: commit_mapping (agent path, refuses AUTO_MAPPED), record_decision (HITL path), export_bundle, import_bundle

components.label: apply_decision (HITL feedback)
components.role: Records human verdict (approve/override/reject) as MAPPED_TO/NOT_MAPPED_TO precedent edge; atomic with upsert_precedent (I5)

components.label: upsert_precedent (write seam)
components.role: Atomic Cypher: single-positive-precedent invariant; signature denormalised; source_content_hash + source_file_audit_id (M8) persisted

components.label: rank_signals_for (derived)
components.role: Counts DISTINCT VendorProducts per node+signature with CONFIRMED MAPPED_TO; idempotent; atomic with precedent write; tilts sort order

components.label: export_bundle (snapshot)
components.role: Reads list_confirmed_precedents, snapshots rank signals, returns a versioned bundle as a JSON string/object with field-normalisation + validation diagnostics — does NOT put_object to S3 (caller persists).

components.label: import_bundle (replay)
components.role: Replays CONFIRMED precedents via upsert_precedent (idempotent); skips unknown nodes; rank signals re-derived

components.label: hydrate (S3 → FalkorDB)
components.role: Container startup: fetches the canonical bundle from S3 (read path), calls import_bundle, blocks the health check until complete.

components.label: persist.commit_mapping
components.role: Verifies verdict seal, layer-3 scope gate, refuses agent AUTO_MAPPED (I5 enforcement); holds agent verdicts in reviewer queue

components.label: persist.record_decision
components.role: Calls apply_decision for human approvals; only path that writes CONFIRMED precedents to canon

components.label: Reviewer queue
components.role: Holds agent-driven AUTO_MAPPED verdicts until human review; not written to canon until persist.record_decision

components.label: ingest_bytes (frame parse)
components.role: Parses vendor frames, calls upsert_vendor_product; denormalises vendor_signature for rank-signal derivation

components.label: RetrievalStore (abstract)
components.role: 13 abstract methods + shared retrieval HELPERS (RRF k=60, BM25, clamps, vendor_signature). Contract: health, close, upsert_taxonomy_node, upsert_vendor_product, upsert_precedent, rank_signals_for, get_negative_precedents, get_taxonomy_node, find_similar_products, get_ontology_neighbourhood, get_precedent_mapping, list_confirmed_precedents, list_taxonomy_nodes (base.py:49-206).

components.label: FalkorDBStore
components.role: Local graph store (Cypher); Jaro-Winkler dense, BM25 lexical, RRF fusion; negative-precedent drop; rank-signal tilt on sort key only

components.label: NeptuneStore
components.role: Production AWS Neptune (SPARQL); same contract as FalkorDB; Neptune semantic retrieval is stub (sim=0.0, M9)

components.label: MemoryStore
components.role: In-memory implementation; DEV/DEMO only; full ladder on laptop

components.label: get_store() factory
components.role: Single swap point (lru_cache); reads STORE_BACKEND env var; returns FalkorDBStore | NeptuneStore | MemoryStore

components.label: S3 canonical bundle
components.role: Canonical snapshot in S3. READ path live (hydrate fetches on boot). WRITE path absent — export_bundle returns JSON, no put_object (bundle.py:113); an external caller uploads.

components.label: Authoritative graph (Neptune)
components.role: Neptune MCP openCypher parameterised queries (CANDIDATE_BY_TERM, NODE_BY_IRI, EXISTING_MAPPING_BY_VENDOR_PRODUCT, CONFLICTS_BY_VENDOR_PRODUCT_REF)

components.label: Bedrock — Lambda path
components.role: backend/scudo/shared/bedrock.py: DEFAULTS us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8 @ us-east-1 (override BEDROCK_LLM_MODEL_ID / AWS_REGION). Bare mapping + verifier agents; cached across warm invocations.

components.label: Bedrock — mapping-MCP path
components.role: scudo_mapping_mcp/agent.py:120: DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID=eu.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8 (eu-west-2). BedrockMappingAgent only when SCUDO_AGENT_BACKEND=bedrock (default is scripted).

components.label: Settings (config.py)
components.role: Single source of truth: STORE_BACKEND, confidence floor 0.80, borderline ±0.05, PRIORITY_VENDORS, SCUDO_USE_OPUS_DENSE, SCUDO_AGENT_BACKEND, etc.

**Deduplication:**
- 'Orchestrator' split into: orchestrator_run (routing+bundle), call_mapping (agent), pre_verify_defects, call_verifier, gate_and_decide (publish gate).
- 'Agent' split into: agent_orchestrator_loop (4-tool sequence), agent_bedrock (Bedrock backend), agent_scripted (testing backend).

- 'Storage' seam: store_seam (abstract contract), falkordb/neptune/memory (implementations), factory (swap point).
- 'Self-improving' loop: upsert_precedent → rank_signals_for → retrieval → matcher (cycles back).

**Agent Tool Loop (agent_orchestrator_loop):**
Step 1: find_similar_products (Rung 3 retrieval, dense arm, rank-signal tilt).
Step 2: get_taxonomy_node (visibility, context for agent narration).
Step 3: get_ontology_neighbourhood (shape visibility).
Step 4: map_vendor_product (matcher gates; final authoritative call).
Agent cannot disagree by construction (contract line 18–26 agent.py).

**Self-Improving Cycle (verdict → precedent → consult → matcher):**
1. persist_record_decision (HITL human pick) → apply_decision → upsert_precedent (MAPPED_TO/NOT_MAPPED_TO edge, atomic, I5 enforcement).
2. rank_signals_for: DERIVED from CONFIRMED edges (count distinct VendorProducts); idempotent; tilts sort order (not similarity).
3. rung3_retrieval consults rank_signals_for to boost candidates (capped boost, subfloor candidates cannot escape 0.80 floor).
4. Next matcher call uses updated signals; CONFIRMED precedent drop filters negative-precedent edges.

**Determinism Invariants:**
- I3 (scope gate, layers 1-3): fail-closed in ingestion_mcp, match_verify_mcp, persistence_mcp; no LLM vote.
- I4 (0.80 floor): upsert_precedent is write-only; rank boost touches sort key only, never Candidate.similarity.
- I5 (HITL-only for auto_mapped): agent AUTO_MAPPED held in reviewer_queue; only persist_record_decision writes to canon.
- I6 (invariants outside model): validations_layer is Python determinism; run_validations required failures force NEEDS_REVIEW regardless of similarity.
- I8 (identity binding): precedent keys + verdict seals flow through vendor+product_id; deterministic IRI regex enforced pre-verify and publish gate.

**MCP Tiers & Scope Gates:**
- Tier 1 (ingestion_mcp): layer 1 scope gate; ingest_bytes normalises vendor data.
- Tier 2 (match_verify_mcp): layer 2 scope gate; match_vendor_product (matcher) gates result.
- Tier 3 (persistence_mcp): layer 3 scope gate (sole writer); persist_commit_mapping refuses agent AUTO_MAPPED; persist_record_decision writes CONFIRMED.
- McpHost (optional): round-robin + circuit-breaker + semaphore across 3 tiers when SCUDO_MCP_HOST_ENABLED=True.

**Verdict Seal (HMAC-SHA256):**
Signs (input_hash, mapped_node_iri, status, confidence, band, ts_ms); v=2 carries band; verify checks shape, HMAC, staleness (max 300s), identity binding via (vendor, product_id).
Stored in VerdictResult; verified by persist_commit_mapping before write (layer-3 gate).

**Named-Graph Determinism:**
uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, vendor_product_iri:ontology_snapshot) → jpmorgan:data:cdao:graphs:enrichment:<uuid5>.
Ensures idempotent publish: re-running same mapping yields same named-graph IRI + triples.

**Cold-Start Hydration (hydrate → bundle_import):**
Container startup: hydrate fetches canonical bundle from S3, calls bundle_import to replay CONFIRMED precedents via upsert_precedent (idempotent MERGE).
Rank signals re-derived from imported edges (no separate signal write needed).
Health check blocks until complete (prevents confident-but-empty serves).

**Bedrock Wiring:**
BedrockModel(model_id=eu.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8, region_name=eu-west-2); cross-region inference for on-demand throughput.
Mapping agent (call_mapping) + Verifier agent (call_verifier) both use Opus 4.8.
Agents cached globally (line 160 lambda_handler.py), reused across warm Lambda invocations (avoids cold-start cost).
